children: BetMGM released a series of product innovations, weekly promotions, and “legendary experiences” ahead of the 2026-2027 football season. The sports betting giant noted the offerings are designed to deliver more value through enhanced pricing and product features, create more opportunities for fans to engage throughout the week, and reward players through loyalty benefits and premium experiences.

The sports betting platforms' new offerings will include exclusive bonuses and special odds tied to Thursday night football games, betting protection on early player injuries, premium spread pricing, and expanded cash-out capabilities.
BetMGM was created in 2018 after MGM Resorts International
and GVC Holdings formed a U.S. online sports betting and iGaming joint venture. The company combined MGM’s casino brand, customer base, and U.S. market access with Entain’s
sportsbook and online gaming technology, expanding as states legalized wagering. It now operates under the BetMGM brand and remains owned 50-50 by MGM Resorts International
, with neither parent wholly controlling it. BetMGM is currently available in 31 markets with mobile and retail offerings.

title: BetMGM expands its sports betting features ahead of the 2026-2027 football season
